name: alex-mods
description: alexcz-a11y's collection of Claude Code mods, one mod per directory.

plugins.name: dispatch-pilot
plugins.description: A decision model outside Claude (Jev or Clef, your choice) picks the main agent's reasoning effort each time you send a message, and suggests the few skills that fit it instead of the full skill listing; the main agent's model never changes, so the prompt cache survives.
